title: Allow (G5) optional raw (unfiltered) plot on graph
symptom: The user wants to see a plot of raw unfiltered (or filtered) data on the Home Screen to observe trends even when normal plotted data changes due to calibration algorithms or history rewriting. The plot should be easy to toggle on/off and optionally adjusted with offset/scale.
evidence_quote: As G5 is becoming an old technology now that G7 is out and as we still have not implemented this, I am going to close this.
